roman = metadata.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n')[1].splitlines()
source = body.strip().splitlines()
assert roman[0] == '  1' and source[0] == '۱'
assert len(roman) == len(source) == 5
assert all(line.startswith('  ') and not line.endswith('.') for line in roman)
assert 'direction: \"rtl\"' in metadata and 'noUrdu' not in metadata
assert '\\u200c' not in body
print('Verified one stanza with four verses in each script.')
PY"
